'''Decklists''' on this wiki are constructed 60s with a cited source. Tournament lists live on the event hub ([[List of SWCCG tournaments]], [[Championships]]). Lists that were never tied to a named tournament live under [[Decipher deck designs]].

Every dested list carries a [[GEMP importable decklist]] Download in Deck info.
